name: Hey_3
short_caption: The robot lifts its right arm and waves its open hand in a friendly greeting.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral standing posture. It raises its right arm up and outward to the side, opening its hand with the palm facing forward. The hand is briefly waved to the side, and then the entire arm is lowered smoothly back to the side of the body, returning to the neutral resting pose.
safety_notes: The robot's right arm sweeps outward to the side and slightly upward. Ensure a clear workspace of at least 60 cm to the robot's right side.
